name: Faster-Whisper
tagline: Fast local speech-to-text transcription engine built on CTranslate2 for offline audio and video subtitles.
real_test_summary: Tested transcribing recorded speech and meeting audio offline with int8 quantization. Runs significantly faster with lower memory footprint than standard PyTorch Whisper pipelines.
pros: High transcription speed and lower memory usage via CTranslate2
Supports int8 and fp16 quantization for offline CPU or GPU runs
MIT license with clean Python API for local batch workflows
cons: Requires Python setup or a wrapper UI for non-CLI users
Long audio files still benefit from GPU acceleration for speed
